A '''hydroshovel''' was a tool. [[Melnea Arnthout]] used a hydroshovel to help free a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], starting a friendship with the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].
